description: Serta Diamond Quilted Micro suede Electric Warming Chair Size Furniture Protector-Because of the popularity of the Serta Electric Warming Products our customers have asked us to create a line of affordable warming accessories for home furniture. The Serta Electric Warming Chair Protector will take comfort and luxury to a whole new level. For anyone that suffers from constantly being cold you know how miserable that can be. Whether it's from poor circulation, cold rooms or simply just wanting more comfort the Serta Electric Warming Chair Protector can provide a level of soothing therapeutic warmth unmatched by any other product on the market. We've constructed this amazing warming protector with a luxurious 100-percent Polyester Micro suede Face that is exceptionally durable, easy to care for and able to withstand years of continuous use. A decorative and functional 4-inch Diamond Quilted Pattern adds a touch of elegance while providing added strength. A 2ounce/yd. polyester fiberfill center adds an additional layer of loft. Non-skid dot backing helps the warming protector will stay in place and eliminate shifting and bunching. The Easy to Use Warming Controller has four different settings right at your fingertips to adjust the level of desired heat. An LED light shows the level of heat being produced and allows for easy nighttime adjustments with out having to turn on the lights. The Warming Controller simply plugs and unplugs into the Warming Protector for storage and cleaning. We've sewn in a pocket on one of the arm flaps to hold the Warming Controller so it is always convenient to use. This Warming Furniture Protector can be conveniently machine washed in warm water. Chair size is 26-Inch long with 22-inch arm protectors and 65-Inch deep to cover seat and back. Serta Electric Warming Blankets, Mattress Pads and Foot Warmers also available through Amazon.
